title: apis-io
description: Read-only MCP server over the APIs.io catalog — discover APIs, providers, tags & artifacts.
summary: Read-only MCP server over the APIs.io catalog — discover APIs, providers, tags & artifacts.
offersHint: Read-only MCP server over the APIs.io catalog — discover APIs, providers, tags & artifacts. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://apis.io/mcp

toolsPreview.name: apis_io_search
toolsPreview.description: START HERE. Federated overview of the APIs.io catalog for a query: the top matching APIs, providers, AND tags in one call, each with its total match count. Filter by tags, artifact types, industry, region, rating band. `limit` is per section. To page/sort the full list of ONE type, use find_apis / find_providers / find_tags; for one entity, get_api / get_provider.

toolsPreview.name: find_apis
toolsPreview.description: Paginated, sortable list of APIs across providers — filter by tag, provider, artifact type, industry, region, or rating band. Use apis_io_search first for a cross-type overview.

toolsPreview.name: get_api
toolsPreview.description: Full detail for one API by aid (provider:api-slug); set include=["content"] to inline artifact bodies.

toolsPreview.name: find_providers
toolsPreview.description: Paginated, sortable list of providers — filter by text, tag, artifact type, industry, region, rating band, or access model (pricing/onboarding/try_now/public). Use apis_io_search first for a cross-type overview.

toolsPreview.name: get_provider
toolsPreview.description: Full detail for one provider: profile, rating, and the APIs it publishes. The heavy `collections` and `common` sections are omitted by default (their counts are still reported) — pass view=full for the whole document, or fields=["common"] for a section. Narrow for cheap reads: fields=["score"] returns just the rating. Relative artifact URLs are resolved to absolute, fetchable ones.

toolsPreview.name: find_tags
toolsPreview.description: Paginated, sortable list of tags in the taxonomy. Use apis_io_search first for a cross-type overview.

toolsPreview.name: get_tag
toolsPreview.description: One tag: its metadata, neighbor tags, and a top sample of its providers and APIs (with totals). Use find_apis?tags=slug / find_providers?tags=slug for the full ranked list, or view=full here.

toolsPreview.name: find_industries
toolsPreview.description: Browse industry verticals; sort by provider/API count.

toolsPreview.name: get_industry
toolsPreview.description: One industry: metadata + a top sample of its member providers (ranked, with the total). Use find_providers?industry=slug for the full list, or view=full here.

toolsPreview.name: find_regions
toolsPreview.description: Browse geographic regions; sort by provider/API count.

toolsPreview.name: get_region
toolsPreview.description: One region: metadata + a top sample of its member providers (ranked, with the total). Use find_providers?region=slug for the full list, or view=full here.

toolsPreview.name: find_areas
toolsPreview.description: Browse the API Evangelist areas taxonomy (authentication, webhooks, payments, …) — curated, scored provider indexes. Search by text; sort by provider count.

toolsPreview.name: get_area
toolsPreview.description: One area: metadata, its dedicated site link, and a top sample of member providers (with the total). Use find_providers?area=slug for the full list, or view=full here.

toolsPreview.name: find_ratings
toolsPreview.description: Ranked ratings leaderboard — filter by band, score range, trend, or facet threshold. Sort by composite (default), delta (biggest gainers), or any quality facet (governance, security, …) to rank providers by that dimension.

toolsPreview.name: get_provider_rating
toolsPreview.description: One provider's full rating breakdown (composite, band, trend, six facets).

toolsPreview.name: get_rating_rubric
toolsPreview.description: The rubric — bands, facet weights, trend thresholds — so an agent can interpret any score.

toolsPreview.name: find_artifacts
toolsPreview.description: Find artifacts of ANY one type across the catalog — the cross-type entry point. Each type also has a dedicated find_<type> tool (find_mcp, find_rules, find_scopes, …) with sorts and filters unique to that type; prefer those when you know the type. Types: mcp, skills, rules, arazzo, plans, rate-limits, finops, collections, asyncapis, graphql, json-ld, channels, examples, json-schemas, json-structures, openapis, postman, vocabularies, apis-json. PRO: scopes, security. include=["content"] inlines bodies.

toolsPreview.name: compare_providers
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Compare 2+ providers side by side: composite/band, per-facet leaders, and an artifact-coverage matrix.

toolsPreview.name: gap_analysis
toolsPreview.description: PRO — For each provider: high-value artifacts it lacks (MCP, Arazzo, Rules, Skills…), what its peers commonly publish but it lacks, and its score vs the peer median — plus stack-level gaps across the set.

toolsPreview.name: whats_changed
toolsPreview.description: PRO — What changed in the catalog since a date: providers added/updated, plus rating movement (up/down) from the latest scoring build.

toolsPreview.name: recommend_stack
toolsPreview.description: Design an API stack — the best-rated catalog provider per capability, assembled into a stack. FREE preview = the top pick per capability; PRO = alternatives, per-pick artifact gaps, and an exportable APIs.json + Arazzo hint. Decompose the domain into capabilities first, then pass them here.

toolsPreview.name: get_provider_artifacts
toolsPreview.description: Every artifact a provider publishes — provider-level (MCP, security, scopes, rules, agentic-access) and per-API (OpenAPI, Arazzo, overlays, reference docs) — grouped by type with counts. by_type_counts is the full summary; pass `type` (e.g. OpenAPI, MCP) to scope the artifacts list to one type, since an unfiltered provider can be 250+ entries.

toolsPreview.name: get_api_artifacts
toolsPreview.description: One API's artifacts grouped by type (by_type_counts is the full summary); pass `type` to scope the list to one type (synonym-aware: MCP matches MCPServer), include=["content"] to inline the bodies.

toolsPreview.name: get_openapi
toolsPreview.description: An API's primary OpenAPI reference (url) — the top agent intent; set include=["content"] to inline the spec body.

toolsPreview.name: get_provider_onboarding
toolsPreview.description: A getting-started view for a provider — website, portal, signup, docs, authentication, base URLs, and first steps assembled from its registered links.

toolsPreview.name: find_similar_providers
toolsPreview.description: Providers similar to a given one (alternatives) by shared tags, industry, region, and artifact coverage.

toolsPreview.name: find_similar_apis
toolsPreview.description: APIs similar to a given one ("more like this") by shared tags.

toolsPreview.name: get_industry_leaders
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Top-rated providers in an industry vertical.

toolsPreview.name: get_region_leaders
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Top-rated providers in a region.

toolsPreview.name: get_area_leaders
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Top-rated providers in a curated API Evangelist area.

toolsPreview.name: get_rating_history
toolsPreview.description: PRO — A provider's rating movement: current score/band/trend and the implied previous-build point.

toolsPreview.name: find_rating_movers
toolsPreview.description: PRO — The biggest rating movers (up and down) since the previous scoring build.

toolsPreview.name: story_leads
toolsPreview.description: OWNER — The weekly "what's worth writing" rollup: ranked story leads from the demand map crossed with rating movement — unmet demand (searched, no result), risers/fallers, and hot-but-thin capabilities. Each lead is a headline, its signal, and a suggested angle. include=["raw"] appends the underlying demand report.

toolsPreview.name: export_dataset
toolsPreview.description: BUSINESS/license tier — the WHOLE dataset in one pull (not a 100-row page): `ratings` (every rated provider with facets, trend, rubric + provenance) or `providers` (the catalog with coverage + score). For media outlets and analysts licensing the data to publish rankings and trends. Attribute to apis.io and cite the rubric.

toolsPreview.name: industry_gap_analysis
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Valuable artifact types (MCP, Arazzo, Rules, Skills…) commonly missing across a whole industry — where the vertical is under-served.

toolsPreview.name: export_stack
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Export a designed capability stack as an adoptable APIs.json document (with an Arazzo hint) the team can commit.

toolsPreview.name: find_company_insights
toolsPreview.description: Browse profiled companies (Fortune 1000) by name; ranked by overall technology-readiness signal. Free discovery.

toolsPreview.name: insights_dimensions
toolsPreview.description: Cross-section ranking of the 40 tracked investment dimensions (AI, cloud, governance, security, …) by how many profiled companies show signal. Free.

toolsPreview.name: insights_adoption
toolsPreview.description: Services, tools, or standards ranked by how many companies adopt them across the profiled set. Free.

toolsPreview.name: get_company_insight
toolsPreview.description: Full demand-side profile for one company: 40-dimension readiness scores, adopted stack, and per-quarter history. Pro.

toolsPreview.name: company_gaps
toolsPreview.description: A company's weakest investment dimensions — where it is thin and a vendor could sell in. Pro.

toolsPreview.name: match_providers
toolsPreview.description: The supply↔demand join: apis.io providers whose product appears in a company's adopted stack, ranked by rating. Pro.

toolsPreview.name: find_vcs
toolsPreview.description: Find venture-capital firms by name, thesis tags, or category. Each carries a network-matched, rated portfolio graph. Sort by portfolio_on_network (default), portfolio_total, portfolio_rating, or name. Free.

toolsPreview.name: get_vc
toolsPreview.description: One VC firm: identity, fund facts, and portfolio summary (totals, band distribution, average rating). Pass view=full to inline the whole portfolio. Free.

toolsPreview.name: vc_portfolio
toolsPreview.description: A VC firm's portfolio companies, each matched to the network and rated. Filter is_provider=true (only API providers), in_network=true, band, or min_score; sort by score (default), api_count, or name. The demand-side view of who a fund has backed. Free.

toolsPreview.name: find_investors
toolsPreview.description: The reverse portfolio edge — which VC firms in the network back a given provider/company (by slug). Free.

toolsPreview.name: resolve
toolsPreview.description: Resolve ANY identifier — website URL, domain (stripe.com), or GitHub org (github.com/stripe) — to the apis.io provider it belongs to. Use this when you have a URL, not a slug. Free.

toolsPreview.name: enrich_provider
toolsPreview.description: One call, pick your field groups — resolves a slug OR any identifier and returns exactly the groups you ask for, instead of chaining get_provider + get_provider_rating + get_provider_artifacts + get_provider_onboarding. Groups: profile, onboarding, artifacts (free); rating, insights (Pro). Free base.

toolsPreview.name: save_search
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Persist the current search criteria as a named saved search you own, so you can re-run it and get net-new results later. Criteria use the same filters as apis_io_search. Requires an apis.io API key.

toolsPreview.name: list_saved_searches
toolsPreview.description: PRO — List the saved searches you own (name, criteria, when last run, how many matches are tracked).

toolsPreview.name: run_saved_search
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Re-run one of your saved searches against the live catalog and return current matching providers.

toolsPreview.name: saved_search_net_new
toolsPreview.description: PRO — What is NEW for a saved search since you last checked: providers that newly match your criteria. Advances the delta cursor, so each call reports only what changed since the previous call. The agent-native version of the demand report.

toolsPreview.name: delete_saved_search
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Delete a saved search you own.

toolsPreview.name: create_list
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Create a named, persistent list (a shortlist / stack you own) of providers or APIs. Requires an apis.io API key.

toolsPreview.name: list_lists
toolsPreview.description: PRO — List the lists/shortlists you own.

toolsPreview.name: get_list
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Get a list you own, with each member resolved to its current name, band, and score.

toolsPreview.name: add_to_list
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Add providers/APIs (by slug or aid) to one of your lists.

toolsPreview.name: delete_list
toolsPreview.description: PRO — Delete a list you own.

toolsPreview.name: find_openapis
toolsPreview.description: OpenAPI specifications across the catalog. The REST contract. get_openapi returns one API's primary spec with optional inlined body. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_asyncapis
toolsPreview.description: AsyncAPI (event-driven) specifications across the catalog. Event/streaming APIs. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_channels
toolsPreview.description: AsyncAPI event channels across the catalog. Individual event channels (topics/streams). Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_graphql
toolsPreview.description: GraphQL schemas across the catalog. GraphQL type systems. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_arazzo
toolsPreview.description: Arazzo workflows across the catalog. Multi-step API workflows chaining operations. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_mcp
toolsPreview.description: MCP servers across the catalog. Model Context Protocol servers a provider offers to agents. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_skills
toolsPreview.description: Agent Skills across the catalog. Packaged agent skills. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_rules
toolsPreview.description: Spectral governance rulesets across the catalog. API design/linting rulesets. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_scopes
toolsPreview.description: OAuth scope catalogs across the catalog. The OAuth scopes an API defines. Pro tier. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_security
toolsPreview.description: Security artifacts across the catalog. Authentication, domain security, VDP, trust center. Pro tier. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_plans
toolsPreview.description: Pricing plans across the catalog. An API's pricing tiers. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_rate_limits
toolsPreview.description: Rate-limit policies across the catalog. Declared throttling policies. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_finops
toolsPreview.description: FinOps / billing models across the catalog. How usage is metered and billed. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_collections
toolsPreview.description: Postman / Open collections across the catalog. Runnable request collections. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_json_ld
toolsPreview.description: JSON-LD contexts across the catalog. Linked-data vocabularies. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_json_schemas
toolsPreview.description: JSON Schemas across the catalog. Standalone data schemas. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_json_structures
toolsPreview.description: JSON Structures across the catalog. Data structures behind an API. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_examples
toolsPreview.description: Example payloads across the catalog. Real request/response examples. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_postman
toolsPreview.description: Postman collections across the catalog. Postman-format collections (by reference). Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_vocabularies
toolsPreview.description: API vocabularies across the catalog. Controlled vocabularies a provider publishes. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

toolsPreview.name: find_apis_json
toolsPreview.description: APIs.json indexes across the catalog. The APIs.json discovery documents themselves. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.
